atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PETOPIA runtime pilot sprite atlas, not a presentation board. Derive usable sprites from the supplied accepted references. Image 1 defines the exact child and Foxy identity; Image 2 defines meadow palette/materials only. Output one square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha, exactly a 4-column by 4-row equal-cell grid, each cell 256x256. No visible grid, labels, numbers, text, UI, logo, ground shadow, backdrop or padding panels. Keep every subject entirely inside its own cell with at least 24 image pixels of clear transparent gutter. All character feet align at local y=224 in each cell. Pixel art: crisp square pixel clusters, dark warm stepped outlines, no blur or antialiasing, cheerful saturated greens/orange/sky blue matching references. Child is the same tousled dark brown-haired kid, green jacket over light shirt, navy shorts, brown boots, small ochre backpack, friendly large eyes, facing RIGHT. Row 1 cells left-to-right: child standing idle side view; child running with extended arms and legs; child airborne jump side view; child throwing a ball with arm extended right BUT NO BALL in the sprite. Row 2: exact Foxy BABY, orange fox with white muzzle, chest and tail tip, black feet, large round head and compact short legs, all facing RIGHT: idle; run; jump; digging with front paws at ground. Row 3: same Foxy CHILD stage with taller legs and fuller tail, same markings, facing RIGHT: idle; run; jump; digging. Keep identity, scale and proportions invariant across each character's row, without changing costumes or adding accessories. Row 4 contains four isolated environment assets: a square grass-topped earth terrain tile whose tile fills a 192x192 square centered in the cell, with a straight green grass top and ochre soil beneath; a square repeatable ochre soil tile same size, fully opaque inside its square; one lush round meadow tree with trunk, no ground base; one low flowering green shrub. Environment texture has the same crisp pixel size as characters. This is a first runtime art pilot, not the final complete animation inventory. Exact 4x4 cell layout is essential for engine import.
background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: runtime far-background panorama for PETOPIA Green Meadows, based on the accepted gameplay reference image. Create a new landscape PNG, wide 2:1 composition, 1536x768 if possible. Reference image is for matching palette and world identity only; do not copy its characters, HUD, coins, platforms, near trees, foreground land or text. Bright clean sky blue, lovely blocky white clouds, layered blue-green hills, a small distant cream-and-blue storybook castle, and a distant friendly cream windmill with orange roof among a meadow village. Keep the castle and windmill small in the middle distance. The bottom third is gentle green meadow/forest depth with very low contrast; no reachable foreground platforms, ground edges or interactive-looking objects. Upper third has airy uncluttered sky so game UI and jump arcs stay readable. Warm, vivid and cheerful for children 5–12, same accepted sunny adventure color direction. Crisp true pixel-art clusters, stepped silhouettes and limited shade ramps; no blur, no smeared brush texture, no photographic rendering or fog wash. Terrain and actors will be separately rendered over this. Opaque full background, no transparency. No people, animals, collectibles, hearts, menus, labels, logo, watermark or frame. This is one reusable distant scenery layer for an initial runtime art pilot.
